decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's integrated airport operations software, another year of customer learning and product refinement reinforces strong absorptive capacity and makes withdrawal unlikely.

Because this connectivity module builds directly on the firm's apron integration knowledge and installed system base, management can readily absorb feedback from deployments and continue improving it.
Apron equipment monitoring remains tightly linked to the firm's maintenance, data, and operational know-how, so the product fits existing capabilities well enough to justify continued development.

Resource management software is closely connected to the firm's core airport efficiency expertise, and cumulative service and project experience should help it learn and strengthen the offer rather than exit.
Although safety-critical services can diffuse more slowly, the product matches the firm's tower and safety systems expertise and benefits from in-house R&D, supporting continued commitment.
